question: In a code language, 'BROWN' is coded as CTRUM and 'ENTER' is coded as FPWCQ . How will 'NOISE' be coded in the same language?
solution:
Here, we use the table given below:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2fba0ad62c95abef9a210f91bc23cdf9e49ba5a7c93d6d3733263aa93efb1bd5.png] ​

The logic followed in the given code language:

'BROWN' is coded as 'CTRUM' →

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2588e7dff53272a8913929144bf6b8f6d80d72c8aa400ecc2f908cbe03547273.png] 

'ENTER' is coded as 'FPWCQ' →

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1d9b8d23663bc18a0310120583088f75daddd8db5bd71c2617d8d4c76b27641c.png] 

Similarly, 'NOISE' will be coded as:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f70bd57c07a488fefdb59888c7a23ea4ca9e04118d44f92929372f1a949bdee9.png] 

Here, 'NOISE' is coded as **'OQLQD'.**

Hence, the correct answer is "Option (4)".
